reason: The source indicates that delayed diagnosis of primary ciliary dyskinesia (PCD) until adulthood may be associated with pre-existing lung bronchiectasis, but it does not establish a direct causal relationship or provide comparative evidence against alternative explanations (e.g., other undiagnosed conditions).
